title: The shared notes need “extra access”
scenario: A study-group member posts a link to a shared notes folder. When you open it, the site asks to connect to your school cloud account and approve access to email, files and contacts.

answers.A: Approve it because the study-group member is someone you know and the notes are real.
answers.B: Do not approve broad access; ask for the notes through the school’s normal drive or a simple file share.
answers.C: Check the app name and permissions with school IT or a trusted adult before connecting anything.

explanation: The sender’s account may be compromised, and broad OAuth permissions can expose much more than the notes.
proTip: A notes folder should not need your inbox.
